entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, hello. I need to return something. This VeloBand Pulse thing. I... I'm just so confused by the website.
I can certainly look into a return for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
Oh, I don't think it's broken. I just... I can't use it. It's been a very difficult few weeks. My son, he had an emergency, and we were all at the hospital with him.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I hope everything is okay.

He needed unexpected surgery, and it's just been a mess. It's complicated because his military deployment is coming up, and this has thrown all our plans into chaos. I honestly forgot I even had this box until today. I just don't understand the rules. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I can help clarify things for you. I'm so sorry you've had to deal with such a stressful family emergency. Let me pull up your account and take a look at the purchase date. One moment.
Okay, I see the order here. It looks like the VeloBand Pulse was delivered to you 24 days ago. Let me just check our official return policy...
Alright, I've got it. Our knowledge base confirms that all VeloFit items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. Since you're only on day 24, you are well within that window.
Oh, really? 90 days? So... so I can send it back? The website made it seem so much shorter.

Yes, absolutely. I can approve this return for a full refund right now. I'll go ahead and email you a prepaid shipping label. All you'll need to do is put the band back in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off.
Wow. That... that is such a relief. Thank you so much, Alex. You've been a great help.
You're very welcome. Again, I wish your son a speedy recovery before his deployment. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
